subject.title: fix(codex): bound app-server websocket handshake waits to requestTimeoutMs

question: Should appServer.requestTimeoutMs be the canonical fail-closed WebSocket upgrade deadline for both TCP and Unix Codex app-server transports?
rationale: The choice avoids a new config surface and fixes an indefinite hang, but it intentionally makes slow legitimate upgrades fail with code 1006 and therefore defines operator-visible timeout policy.

options.title: Reuse request timeout
options.body: Use the existing resolved requestTimeoutMs as the single request and upgrade budget for both transports, with no new setting.

options.title: Add a distinct upgrade policy
options.body: Define a separately approved handshake deadline or compatibility mode, accepting an additional configuration or default surface.

options.title: Keep unbounded upgrades
options.body: Reject fail-closed handshake behavior and retain the existing indefinite-wait risk.

recommendation.title: Reuse request timeout
recommendation.body: Use the existing resolved requestTimeoutMs as the single request and upgrade budget for both transports, with no new setting.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Codex app-server runtime history makes this the best available owner for choosing the transport timeout contract.
